tooltip.gundevourer.simple: §7Every gun finds its way into the armory.
tooltip.gundevourer.true.active: §5True damage: §dACTIVE §8(%1$s%% of the hit's damage, leaves at least %2$s HP)
tooltip.gundevourer.detail.title: §6§l— ZENITH ARMORY —
tooltip.gundevourer.detail.1: §7Devour: hold this item and right-click a TaCZ gun in any inventory or container.
tooltip.gundevourer.detail.2: §7Each gun ID can be devoured only once; the gun is consumed.
tooltip.gundevourer.detail.3: §7Each devoured gun type grants §c+%1$s §7gun damage; every %2$s types grants §d+%3$s%%§7 gun damage.
tooltip.gundevourer.detail.4: §7Multi-pellet guns split the bonus across pellets; a full hit still adds the same total.
tooltip.gundevourer.detail.5: §7At §d%1$s§7 devoured types, gun hits deal an additional §d%2$s%%§7 of the hit's damage as absolute true damage.
tooltip.gundevourer.detail.6: §7Equip in a Curios charm slot to activate. Only one can be equipped per player.
tooltip.gundevourer.detail.7: §7True damage bypasses i-frames; only entities in the immunity tag are immune.
tooltip.gundevourer.detail.8: §7True damage cannot kill; it leaves the target at %1$s HP at minimum.
message.gundevourer.devoured: Devoured! %1$s gun types consumed, gun damage +%2$s
message.gundevourer.already: This gun type has already been devoured
command.gundevourer.set: Set Zenith Armory devoured count to %1$s (0 = clear)
command.gundevourer.no_item: No Zenith Armory found in your inventory or Curios slots
